newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Walker sells properties to Heine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Walker sells properties to Heine.

text.p: Walker Corp Ltd said on Tuesday announced a deal with Heine Managed Trusts which it said could generate more than A$90 million for the company through the sale of property and development rights.
It said it had sold five industrial developments to Heine for a total of A$63 million. The properties were in South Australia, Melbourne and New South Wales.
Further development rights had also been agreed on residual land at the sites.
"These development rights have the potential to generate over A$25 million income for Walker," Walker said.

Lang Walker, the firm's managing director, said: "This agreement reinforces the strategic direction we undertook over 18 months ago to acquire well located sites in anticipation of the demand for purpose-built industrial facilities which we knew would follow any predicted return of confidence in the economy."
